mapper.sql: t.team_id, t.team_code, t.team_name, t.description, t.status, t.created_at, t.created_by, t.updated_at, t.updated_by, t.deleted_at, t.deleted_by, t.version, COALESCE(mc.member_count, 0) AS member_count

choose.when: t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 'DELETED'

where.if: AND ( LOWER(t.team_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(t.team_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_dim_team t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM tbl_team_member WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY team_id ) mc ON mc.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId}

SELECT FROM tbl_dim_team t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM tbl_team_member WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY team_id ) mc ON mc.team_id = t.team_id
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.team_code ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_team ( team_id, team_code, team_name, description, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, version ) VALUES ( #{teamId}, #{teamCode}, #{teamName}, #{description}, #{status}::record_status, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_team SET team_code = #{teamCode}, team_name = #{teamName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}::record_status, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH updated_members AS ( UPDATE tbl_team_member SET status = 'INACTIVE', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' RETURNING team_member_id ) UPDATE tbl_dim_team SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT tm.team_member_id, tm.team_id, t.team_name, tm.member_key, m.pseudonym, tm.role_id, r.role_name, tm.status, tm.joined_at, tm.created_at, tm.created_by, tm.updated_at, tm.updated_by, tm.deleted_at, tm.deleted_by, tm.version FROM tbl_team_member tm INNER JOIN tbl_dim_team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id INNER JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = tm.member_key INNER JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = tm.role_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND tm.status = #{status}::record_status
ORDER BY tm.created_at DESC, m.pseudonym ASC

SELECT tm.team_member_id, tm.team_id, t.team_name, tm.member_key, m.pseudonym, tm.role_id, r.role_name, tm.status, tm.joined_at, tm.created_at, tm.created_by, tm.updated_at, tm.updated_by, tm.deleted_at, tm.deleted_by, tm.version FROM tbl_team_member tm INNER JOIN tbl_dim_team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id INNER JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = tm.member_key INNER JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = tm.role_id WHERE tm.team_member_id = #{teamMemberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_team_member ( team_member_id, team_id, member_key, role_id, status, joined_at, deleted_at, deleted_by, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version ) VALUES ( #{teamMemberId}, #{teamId}, #{memberKey}, #{roleId}, #{status}::record_status, #{joinedAt}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_team_member SET status = 'INACTIVE', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE team_member_id = #{teamMemberId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.member_key, m.pseudonym, COALESCE(a.fullname, m.pseudonym) AS fullname FROM tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m LEFT JOIN tbl_auth_user_account a ON a.member_key = m.member_key WHERE (m.active_to IS NULL OR m.active_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
AND ( LOWER(m.pseudonym) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(a.fullname, m.pseudonym)) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(CAST(m.member_key AS TEXT)) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )
ORDER BY m.pseudonym ASC
SELECT role_id, role_name FROM tbl_dim_role ORDER BY role_name ASC
